title: x402 evidence lens — frozen classification procedure; first external datasets: RAEN before-fix capture and Zambo A5 production receipt

subject.component: RAEN settlement ledger (before request-id change) + Zambo A5 lost-response production receipt (x402#4198)

prereg.row_definition: one row = one submission attempt: tuple (payer, idempotency key, intent digest) pinned inside the hash-bound manifest bytes, plus the result binding (result digest + execution record reference, if any); both attempts of a pair are carried, including rejected submissions
prereg.pass_rule: records-only classification: a checker holding only the frozen records - no wallet_ops, no transport logs, no operator word - sorts each second submission as delivery-retry | second-execution | separate-purchase | absent; timing never decides, the record does

case_matrix.expected: boundary negative control: two independent executions

case_matrix.case: same purchase, retry after fulfillment-latency timeout
case_matrix.expected: delivery of the first execution unless a second execution record exists; absent if no hash-bound identity ties the submissions

boundaries: no vendor-defined standard enters the matrix; any record shape that places the tuple inside hash-bound bytes satisfies the lens (AER-1 or otherwise)
the same key proves only that the caller asserted the same purchase identity; only the records can show whether a second execution happened
a result digest proves the saved record was not changed after saving; it does not make the fields true
the classification is derived by the checker at run time and is never precomputed into evidence (RUNBOOK 6.5)

datasets.note: registered before the run: rows are settlement-shaped (no purchase-identity fields), so every adjacent near-duplicate pair is expected to classify as absent under the frozen rule

registered before the run: the C4 production record posted by zambodotdev in x402-foundation/x402#4198 on 2026-11-22T17:10Z (A5 delayed leg of the lost-response runs) is a single hash-bound journal entry (lost_response_probe, sequence 1, declared side effect state_write) with no payment attempt tuple and no pair of submissions in the record set, so under the frozen rule the registered expectation is absent on the C4 classification; fuller leg records, if posted later, enter as a new pinned dataset per the extension rule

prereg.extension_rule: further datasets enter as new pinned runs under this frozen procedure; any change to rows, pass rule or boundaries requires a new pre-registration

notes: Two conditions accepted in x402-foundation/x402#4198 (2026-11-22, zambodotdev): (1) the pass condition is the classification itself, unsortable rows report absent, not a pass by operator account; (2) attempt-shaped rows - the attempt is the row unit of this pre-registration. Case C4 wording follows the records-only formulation confirmed in-thread on 2026-11-22. Second dataset registered before the run: the C4 production record posted by zambodotdev in x402-foundation/x402#4198 on 2026-11-22T17:10Z (zambo.dev/run/2e9ebf1f-5743-48de-a34b-5b3584c4c102, verification API captured byte-exact; commitment recomputed at capture). The record binds one journal entry inside hash-covered canonical bytes but carries no payment attempt tuple, so the registered expectation is absent on the C4 classification; the classification is derived at run time. First classification run (run_ts): sandbox-stand, freeze commit 2991a080c7a637f578e0837411aa5dc38c4eed19; leg A self-run reproduces the sealed verdicts of #0021 with zero divergences; leg B derives absent on all six adjacent pairs of the RAEN before-fix capture (matches the registered expectation); leg C derives absent on the C4 question for the Zambo A5 production record (matches the registered expectation); total divergences 0. Run pack: attestations/evidence/0028-evidence-lens-run/.

self_run.procedure: recompute the frozen classification offline against the sealed attempt rows of record #0021 (argus-seal-0021); derivation must reproduce the sealed verdicts
self_run.divergence: any divergence means the draft is wrong: fix before any external run
